sentences.sentence: If you find a magic lamp, you can wish for whatever you want.
Sir Prize will grant your wishes if you are his master.
If Parvaneh didn't work, Aladdin would not have food to eat.
Jabali would be happy if he stole the lamp for Aladdin.
If Jabali had the magic lamp, he would run away with it.
If Aladdin knew about Jabali's plan, he would not go to the mountain.
Jabali wouldn't need to work ever again if he had the magic lamp.
Parvaneh can have a happy ending if she can retire from work forever.
